claims.text: Infosys's operations predominantly relate to providing end-to-end business solutions to enable clients to enhance business performance.

Its business segments are primarily enterprises in Financial Services and Insurance, Manufacturing, Retail/Consumer Packaged Goods/Logistics, Energy/Utilities/Resources/Services, Communication/Telecom OEM/Media, Hi-Tech, and Life Sciences and Healthcare, plus all other segments.

The main activity is software application development and maintenance and IT consulting, which accounted for 94.5% of turnover; the passage does not state a standalone or consolidated basis for that figure.
On the Q4 FY2024-25 call, Salil Parekh said clients are moving from a use-case approach to an AI-led transformation approach, with AI agents playing a critical role.
claims.speaker: Salil Parekh

claims.text: On the Q4 FY2024-25 call, Jayesh Sanghrajka said FY'26 growth is expected at 0% to 3% in constant currency terms. This excludes the acquisition announced that day and assumes a reduction in third-party revenues versus FY'25 based on existing deals and new deals in the pipeline. He said operating margin guidance is 20% to 22%.
claims.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

claims.text: On the Q4 FY2024-25 call, Jayesh Sanghrajka said global uncertainties relating to tariffs and their impact on client sentiment and spend are taking center stage. He said the company will keep a close watch on the economic environment and its impact on client budgets and reassess guidance as the year progresses.
claims.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

claims.text: In the earlier Q3 FY2024-25 call, Jayesh Sanghrajka said FY'25 revenue guidance was being revised to 4.5% to 5% in constant currency terms, with operating margin guidance remaining at 20% to 22%.
claims.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka
